questions.questionText: When writing a function to compute the minimum product of a subset of an integer array using the greedy approach described, under which condition should the function return the product of all array elements?
options: There are an even number of negative numbers and at least one zero
There are an odd number of negative numbers and no zeros
questions.correctAnswer: There are an odd number of negative numbers and no zeros
questions.explanation: The evidence states that if there are an odd number of negative numbers and no zeros, the minimum product is obtained by multiplying all elements. In other cases, different handling (e.g., excluding the largest negative) is required.

questions.questionText: During each iteration of binary search on a sorted array, which comparison is performed to decide the next sub‑array to search?
options: The input key is compared with the middle element of the current sub‑array
The input key is compared with the first element of the array
The input key is compared with the last element of the array
The input key is compared with a randomly chosen element
questions.correctAnswer: The input key is compared with the middle element of the current sub‑array
questions.explanation: Binary search examines the middle element of the current search interval; if the key is less, it continues on the left half, otherwise on the right half. This comparison determines the next sub‑array.
